scenario.title: First Scenario
scenario.objective: Keep exploring before the haunt begins; after the haunt begins, find the mummy's true name, learn the banishment spell, and banish it before the wedding.
scenario.heroGoal: Find the true name in the sarcophagus room, Study, or Library; have the Book holder learn the spell; bring the Book to the mummy and win the Sanity contest.
scenario.traitorGoal: Help the mummy take the Girl plus either the Holy Symbol or Ring back to the sarcophagus. The traitor also wins if every hero dies.
scenario.monsterGoal: The mummy is a monster with Might 8, Speed 3, and Sanity 5. Heroes learn the true name, learn the banishment spell, and banish the mummy; the traitor helps the mummy return to the sarcophagus with the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or Ring.
scenario.readerLead: Heroes find the true name, learn the spell, and banish the mummy with Sanity; the traitor helps the mummy return to the sarcophagus with the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or Ring.
scenario.readerStatusHeroBook: You are a hero: Hero Scenario Book
scenario.readerStatusTraitorBook: You are the traitor: Traitor Scenario Book

reader.prologue:
Dry scraping comes from the sarcophagus. The mummy wakes, turns toward the Girl, and every step through the house starts to feel like a march toward a wedding that should never happen.

The explorer who revealed the haunt becomes the traitor and remains in the game.
reader.setup:
Place the mummy and the sarcophagus in the traitor's room. Set the Girl omen aside from its holder, then place the Girl marker in a discovered room far from the mummy.

Prepare 2 knowledge tokens: the first means the true name is found, and the second means the banishment spell is learned. After setup, the player to the traitor's left takes the first turn.
reader.heroManual:
Heroes complete two knowledge steps in order. First, make a 6+ Knowledge roll in the sarcophagus room, Study, or Library to find the mummy's true name and gain the first knowledge token.

After the true name is found, the hero holding the Book may make a 6+ Knowledge roll to learn the banishment spell and gain the second knowledge token. Then the Book must reach the mummy's room before any hero in that room can attempt the final banishment.
reader.circleManual:
The final banishment is a Sanity attack against the mummy. It is available only after the heroes have 2 knowledge tokens, the spell is learned, and a living hero with the Book is in the mummy's room.

If the Mummy is defeated, the heroes win.
reader.traitorManual:
The traitor helps the mummy take the Girl, then bring the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or Ring back to the sarcophagus room.

Explorers can pick up the Girl, give the Girl to the Mummy in the same room, and give the Holy Symbol or Ring to the Mummy in the same room. The traitor wins when the Mummy returns to the sarcophagus with the Girl and either required omen. The traitor also wins if every hero dies.
reader.spiritManual:
The mummy is a monster with Might 8, Speed 3, and Sanity 5. It attacks only with Might, and heroes may not make Speed attacks against it.

When rolling for the mummy's movement, a result of 0 or 1 lets it move instantly to any room in the house. The mummy can carry items; when an attack would deal 2 or more damage, it can steal instead of making the defender reduce traits.
reader.exorcismManual:
Heroes must complete these steps in order: find the true name, learn the banishment spell, then banish the mummy.

Each hero can attempt only one haunt special action per turn. The Book must be in the final room, but the hero who starts the banishment does not have to personally hold it.
reader.endingManual:
Heroes win by finding the true name, learning the spell, and banishing the mummy with Sanity.

The traitor wins when the mummy returns to the sarcophagus with the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or Ring, or when all heroes die.

mummyRampage.title: Mummy Rampage
mummyRampage.objective: Heroes learn the true name, learn the spell, and banish the Mummy before the wedding is completed.
mummyRampage.heroGoal: Find the true name, learn the spell with the Book, then use Sanity to banish the Mummy.
mummyRampage.traitorGoal: Help the Mummy carry the Girl and the Holy Symbol or Ring back to the Sarcophagus room.
mummyRampage.nextFallback: Find the true name, learn the spell, or reach the Mummy

reader.prologue: Dry scraping comes from the sarcophagus. The mummy wakes, turns toward the Girl, and every step through the house starts to feel like a march toward a wedding that should never happen.
reader.prologueHeroes: Dust suddenly swirls through the room, and a shadow of dread crosses your mind. Not far away, you hear a friend's cry, mixed with fear and a trace of excitement. A strange, deep voice echoes in your head: "My beloved was lost in the ancient flood. Though my tears have turned to ash, love still burns in my heart like the sun. Now my love has returned. We shall never be parted! Anyone who stops me will die, body and soul!"
reader.prologueTraitor:
There is a crack in the wall. When you touch it, the wall slides aside, revealing a dusty sarcophagus covered in strange designs. The markings on the sarcophagus glow faintly, and you cannot help studying what must be ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs.

A strange, deep voice flashes through your mind: "My beloved was lost in the ancient flood. Though my tears have turned to ash, love still burns in my heart like the sun. Now my love has returned. We shall never be parted! You will not stop our union!" Your mind goes blank. You know only that, to let true lovers be together, sacrificing your friends is worthwhile. The sarcophagus slowly opens, and you gaze devoutly upon your master.
reader.setup:
Your character has become the traitor but continues playing.

Take the large Mummy monster token and a pentagonal item token, which represents the sarcophagus, and place them in your room.

You immediately lose the Girl companion. Discard the Girl omen and lose its effect. Set the Girl omen aside, take a magenta token to represent the Girl, and place it in another room on the same floor as the Mummy. The Girl and Mummy must be at least 5 rooms apart. If the floor is too small for that, place the Girl token in the room farthest from the Mummy.
reader.heroes:
The traitor is trying to complete the wedding between the Mummy and the Girl.

Banish the Mummy back to the land of the dead before the Mummy marries the Girl.
reader.traitor:
They are trying to banish the Mummy back to the land of the dead.

The Mummy must hold the Girl omen and either the Holy Symbol omen or the Ring omen, then return to the room with the sarcophagus token. If all heroes die, you also win. Check whether the Holy Symbol omen or Ring omen has been discovered. If neither has been discovered, then when you explore a new room and reveal an omen, search the omen deck for the Holy Symbol or Ring. Then shuffle the omen deck.
reader.monster:
Speed 3, Might 8, Sanity 5

When rolling for the Mummy's movement, if the result is 0 or 1, the Mummy may instantly move to any room in the house. The Mummy can carry items like a normal character and can steal. Items do not change the Mummy's traits. If you are in the same room as the Mummy, you may give the Girl omen or any item to the Mummy.

If the Mummy is in the same room as any hero, it must attack that hero if possible.

The Mummy attacks only with Might. A defeated hero must reduce Speed first. Only when Speed has reached its lowest value may that hero reduce Might. When a character's Might reaches the skull symbol, that character is dead.

Whenever the Mummy successfully deals 2 or more damage, the player may choose to steal one item from the opponent instead; that opponent does not reduce any traits. The Mummy can take the Girl omen this way.

Any Speed attack against the Mummy has no effect, including Dynamite and the Revolver.
reader.endingHeroes:
As you close the Book, hot winds swirl around you. The Mummy staggers toward you, weak hands closing around your neck. You stare into its desperate eyes, and in an instant the Mummy scatters like fine sand in the wind. In your ears you hear: wife, beloved, all gone like smoke...

When the hot wind stops, you look around and find yourself alone.
reader.endingTraitor:
The little girl cowers in the corner, her tearful eyes begging for mercy.

The Mummy slowly walks to the girl. With withered hands it gently lifts her, ignores her cries, and blows into her mouth. Her sobbing fades. Her eyes roll back, faintly glowing yellow.

"My priest, my beloved..." the girl sings in the Mummy's arms. "Soon the whole world will bow beneath us. Their flesh will burn for us. Their souls will feast us..."

crimsonJack.title: Crimson Jack Returns
crimsonJack.objective: Heroes investigate Jack, prepare circles, and exorcise; the traitor hunts heroes.
crimsonJack.heroGoal: Investigate Jack and circles, then exorcise Jack's Spirit.
crimsonJack.traitorGoal: Stop the exorcism and make every hero fall.
crimsonJack.nextFallback: Investigate Jack or study a circle

reader.prologue:
Parents once warned children about Crimson Jack: stay out too late and he would come for you.

As the explorers speak about the killer, one companion smiles in a way that feels wrong. The explorer who revealed the haunt is the traitor.
reader.setup:
The heroes have no extra setup. After the haunt begins, the player to the traitor's left takes the first turn.

Needed tokens: Jack's Spirit, 2 Sanity tokens as exorcism circles, and 2 Might tokens as Knowledge of Jack.
reader.heroes:
Heroes investigate Jack and study exorcism circles. A hero in the Library may Learn about Jack; a hero on an Event-symbol tile may Study the Exorcism.

Jack's Spirit appears only after the traitor falls; a hero who has learned about Jack gains a bonus when attacking the traitor. Once Jack's Spirit appears, a hero on the same tile may attempt the final Sanity exorcism. Circles improve that roll.
reader.special:
A successful study places an exorcism circle on the current tile. If both circles are already placed, move one to the current tile instead.

Each circle in the same region helps the final exorcism.
reader.traitor:
The traitor wins when every hero is dead. At the start of the haunt, the traitor heals all traits and improves physical traits.

The traitor should slow investigation, block circles, and attack heroes. If the traitor dies, Jack's Spirit appears and keeps the pressure on.
reader.monster:
When the traitor dies, place Jack's Spirit on the farthest Omen-symbol tile from the corpse. Jack's Spirit is a monster that moves and attacks heroes.

If Jack's Spirit returns to the traitor corpse tile, the traitor heals and returns to play.
reader.ending:
Heroes win when Jack's Spirit is exorcised and the survivors escape.

The traitor wins when every hero is dead and Crimson Jack's story remains in the house.
reader.endingSurvivors: A flash of light, a puff of smoke, and the smell of brimstone remain as Jack's Spirit vanishes. You hope you never see him again.
reader.endingTraitor: Whistle a happy tune. Your friends are cut to pieces, and you can finally settle back into the old house.

dust.title: The Dust
dust.objective: Heroes search for the cure and heal the Dust; the Dust wears them down with sickness.
dust.heroGoal: Find Research tokens, then cure the Dust.
dust.traitorGoal: Spread sickness and stop the cure.
dust.nextFallback: Search for cure or exchange sickness

reader.prologue: When the vial breaks, a wrong gray haze rises through the house. It crawls into throats, eyes, and wounds until the explorers cough, burn, and doubt each other.
reader.setup:
After Haunt 3, The Dust, each explorer receives sickness tokens. Some tokens can turn explorers into agents of the Dust.

Heroes need Research tokens from rooms before they can attempt the cure.
reader.heroes:
The hero route is direct: search for the cure, collect enough Research, then cure the Dust.

Explorers in the same room may exchange sickness tokens. Exchanges can concentrate safer tokens or expose who has already been compromised.
reader.special:
Research tokens represent progress against the Dust. Cure attempts use Research as help.

Sickness affects explorers as turns advance, so read both current traits and who carries sickness.
reader.traitor:
Explorers controlled by the Dust should delay research, spread sickness, and make cure attempts dangerous.

Stay close to heroes, force exchanges, and keep pressure on cure rooms.
reader.ending:
Heroes win when the Dust is cured and survivors break the sickness.

The Dust wins when sickness overtakes the explorers and only gray haze remains.
reader.endingSurvivors: You plunge a makeshift syringe into your arm, and your cough quickly ceases. You stop seeing red, but the dust particles continue to float throughout the house. You’d best leave quickly, before your immunity wears off.
reader.endingTraitor: The feverish rush out of the house to wreak havoc upon the town. Dust to dust.

bloodFromStone.title: Blood from a Stone
bloodFromStone.objective: Heroes make every Stone Cherub face another and vanish; the Haunt wears heroes down with staring stone.
bloodFromStone.heroGoal: Move, bait, and play Peekaboo to remove every Stone Cherub.
bloodFromStone.traitorGoal: No fixed traitor: the Stone Cherubs and the house threaten every hero.
bloodFromStone.nextFallback: Move beside a Cherub or into a Cherub's line of sight

reader.prologue: The statues are no longer decorations. Each time you turn away, they seem a little closer; each blink makes their stone smiles sharper.
reader.setup:
After Haunt 5, Blood from a Stone, Stone Cherubs enter the house. Place one in each hero's room first, then place the extra Cherubs outside hero line of sight when possible; if there are not enough rooms, players choose discovered rooms for the remaining Cherubs.

Stone Cherubs are not normal enemies and cannot be solved through ordinary attacks.
reader.heroes:
Heroes must make every Stone Cherub disappear. A hero may play Peekaboo when one Stone Cherub is on the same tile and another Stone Cherub is in line of sight.

Peekaboo is a Knowledge check; a Mirror helps. Success removes those two Cherubs. Failure causes general damage.
reader.special:
Stone Cherubs threaten heroes through line of sight. At the end of the monster turn, each hero also suffers queued gaze damage for Cherubs they can see.

Heroes need to use room position and line of sight to pair Cherubs into disappearing groups.
reader.monster:
Stone Cherubs are not defeated through ordinary attacks. They move toward heroes, but if they already begin in a hero's line of sight, they do not move that turn.

Their danger is position and sight, not a normal attack.
reader.ending:
Heroes win when the last pair of Stone Cherubs vanishes and the survivors escape.

The Haunt wins when every hero is dead and the Stone Cherubs claim the house.
reader.endingSurvivors: The final two Stone Cherubs stare at each other as cracks split their wings and smiles. When the rubble settles, the house is finally quiet.
reader.endingHaunt: When the last hero falls, the Stone Cherubs return to their places. Their smiles look more human than when you entered.

helpingHands.title: Helping Hands
helpingHands.objective: Free-for-all: take the Strange Amulet and be the last explorer alive.
helpingHands.heroGoal: Hold the Strange Amulet and use Troll Hand pressure against the other explorers.
helpingHands.traitorGoal: No fixed traitor: every explorer is an opponent.
helpingHands.nextFallback: Fight for the Strange Amulet and move the Troll Hands

reader.prologue: A chewing sound moves inside the walls. The house reaches out with hands that obey whoever holds the Strange Amulet.
reader.setup:
When “The House Is Hungry” triggers Haunt 12, Helping Hands, if no one has the Strange Amulet, search the item deck and give it to the haunt revealer.

Place the Monster Card to the revealer's left. Place one Troll Hand in the Entrance Hall and one in the Basement Landing. The player to the revealer's left takes the first turn.
reader.heroes:
Each explorer is trying to survive alone. You win by holding the Strange Amulet while every other explorer is dead.

The current Strange Amulet holder controls the Troll Hands. If no one has the amulet, skip the monster turn.
reader.special:
Troll Hands have Might 5, Speed 3, Sanity 4, and Knowledge 4, and cannot be stunned. If both Troll Hands are in the same room, they may make one combined Might 8 attack and both Troll Hands spend their attack for the turn.

When you win a Might attack against another explorer, you may steal one item or omen instead of dealing damage.
reader.traitor: This haunt has no fixed traitor and no hidden team. The Strange Amulet holder, Troll Hand locations, and monster controller are public.
reader.ending:
You win when you hold the Strange Amulet and every other explorer is dead.

If the Strange Amulet changes hands, Troll Hand control changes immediately.
reader.endingSurvivors: The Strange Amulet is still in your hand. The hands in the walls fall quiet, as if the house has accepted its new owner.
reader.endingTraitor: The Strange Amulet ends with the final winner. The other explorers have no more chances to escape the hands in the walls.

magicCamera.title: The Magic Camera
magicCamera.objective: The traitor captures Essence; heroes must smash the Magic Camera.
magicCamera.heroGoal: Find and smash the Magic Camera.
magicCamera.traitorGoal: Photograph heroes and capture every Essence.
magicCamera.nextFallback: Take a photo or smash the Magic Camera

reader.prologue: After the Magic Camera flashes, shadows inside the photographs start to move. The lens is not just recording reality; it is stealing Essence.
reader.setup: After Haunt 33, The Magic Camera, the Magic Camera holder becomes the traitor. Phantom photographers enter play, and hero Essence becomes the core win condition.
reader.heroes:
Heroes must stop the traitor from taking photos and ultimately smash the Magic Camera. While the camera survives, every hero Essence remains at risk.

If a hero can reach the camera holder, look for the smash-camera opportunity.
reader.special:
When the traitor photographs a hero, that hero's Essence is captured. Phantom photographers help pressure and attack heroes.

The goal card tracks captured Essence, remaining Essence, active photographers, and camera status.
reader.traitor: The traitor uses the Magic Camera to photograph heroes and capture all Essence. Protect the camera and use phantom photographers until every Essence is taken.
reader.ending:
Heroes win when the Magic Camera is smashed and trapped Essence returns.

The traitor wins when every hero Essence is captured and the shadows replace them.
reader.endingSurvivors: When the Magic Camera shatters, the trapped Essence returns to the bodies it belonged to. The shadows retreat, and the shutter falls silent.
reader.endingTraitor: When the last photograph develops, every hero's Essence is gone. The shadows in the prints look up and walk out in their place.

mummyRules.traits: Mummy traits: Might 8, Speed 3, Sanity 5; it attacks with Might by default.
mummyRules.attack: Hero victory uses the banishment steps, not killing the Mummy with normal attacks; Speed attacks against it are ineffective, including Revolver and Dynamite.
mummyRules.movement: When its movement roll is 0 or 1, the Mummy may teleport to any discovered room; normal movement still spends remaining movement one room at a time.
mummyRules.steal: The Mummy can carry Items and Omens; when an attack would deal 2 or more damage, it may steal one Item, Omen, or the Girl instead of making the defender reduce traits.
mummyRules.victory: Hero victory follows the hero book steps: find the true name, learn the banishment spell, bring the Book and Mummy into the same room, then attack with Sanity. If the Mummy is defeated, it is banished.

mainPath.title: Main Tutorial: Core Turn to First Hero Goal Action
mainPath.description: Start before the haunt and move naturally through one core turn: movement, exploration, event resolution, Book use, Rabbit's Foot reroll, damage allocation, a natural haunt reveal, and the first hero goal action.

steps.endTurnAfterEvent: After damage allocation, discovering the Event room has already ended your turn. Choose End Turn to pass play to your teammate.
steps.watchTeammateOneOmenTurn: It is not your turn now. Teammate 1 first moves back beside the Entrance Hall, explores a ground-floor Omen room, and reveals the Ring; this haunt roll does not trigger.
steps.teammateOneOmenResults: Teammate 1 gains the Ring, and the haunt has not started. Play passes to teammate 2.
steps.watchTeammateTwoOmenTurn: Teammate 2 moves into the newly discovered ground-floor room, explores an adjacent Omen room, and reveals Dog; this haunt roll still does not trigger.
steps.teammateTwoOmenResults: After Dog is confirmed, play returns to you. You are still in the Kitchen; this turn, move to the Upper Landing beside the Library, then wait for the haunt goal before entering it.
steps.moveToGrandStaircase: You already know movement. Stay in move mode and move from the Kitchen through the Hallway to the Grand Staircase; it connects the floors.
steps.switchToUpperFloor: At the Grand Staircase, the floor switcher shows an upper-floor move target. Choose the up arrow to switch the map to the upper floor and reveal the Upper Landing.
steps.moveToUpperLanding: The Upper Landing is now visible. Choose it to move beside the Library; this step only completes the movement you can legally make this turn.
steps.endTurnFromUpperLanding: You are on the Upper Landing, with the Library to the west. Do not continue exploring this turn; choose End Turn so your teammate can keep exploring until an Omen roll naturally starts the haunt.
steps.watchTeammateHauntTrigger: Teammate 1 explores from the new ground-floor room and reveals the Mask. This Omen roll reaches 5+, so the haunt starts naturally.
steps.teammateConfirmHauntTrigger: Teammate 1 reads the Mask and haunt roll result, confirms it, and the game moves into the haunt.

basicSetup.title: Core Turn: Move, Explore, Use
basicSetup.description: Before the haunt begins, you may move, discover a new room, and take special Item or Omen actions in any order. Discovering a new room ends your turn; trade is taught in its own topic.

steps.setupRuntime: Before the haunt begins, learn one core turn: move to a room, discover a new room, reveal a discovery card, and see how the turn closes.
steps.objectiveAndTurn: It is your turn. Start with Move: moving changes your room and decides which unexplored doorway you can use next.
steps.traitsAndSpeed: At the start of your turn, check your Speed. It is the most rooms your explorer can move this turn.
steps.traitTrackReading: The green number on a trait track is the starting value; the highlighted slot is the current value, and the skull is death, not a number. Repeated values are still separate slots.
steps.movesRemaining: Check Speed at the start of the turn; the movement marker in the upper-right shows the movement left this turn. A mid-turn Speed change does not change movement already set for the turn.
steps.roomBoard: Each point of movement lets you move to an adjacent tile. Adjacent tiles share a directly connected doorway. Check your room, the connected rooms, and the unexplored doorways.
steps.observeTeammate: Click a teammate's character area to observe that explorer and move the camera to that room. Click the same teammate again to return to the place you were viewing before, not always to yourself.
steps.focusSelfRoom: After the camera leaves your position, Focus My Room returns it to your explorer's room.
steps.hauntRiskTrack: The omen track records the number of Omens discovered, and the highlighted slot is the current value. When an Omen is drawn, roll dice equal to the total number of Omens held by all players; on a result of 5+, the haunt begins.
steps.inventoryAndHelp: Event cards enter the current event resolution when revealed and do not stay in front of you; Items and Omens do. Choose the relevant card here when you use, trade, or resolve a card effect.
steps.viewBook: First click the magnifier on the Book and read the card: this non-combat check can spend 1 Sanity to use Knowledge instead. Close the card when you are done.
steps.useBook: Now use the Book itself. After you spend 1 Sanity, this Event check rerolls with Knowledge.
steps.openMoveTargets: Choose Move, then choose an adjacent room. Each point of movement reaches one adjacent room.
steps.moveToHallway: Move into the Hallway; its unexplored doorway can reveal a new room.
steps.exploreUpper: Choose the explorable face-down room, then choose an exit. After revealing it, first read the room tile and the connecting doorway.
steps.rotateRoomPlacement: Rotate the new room and choose an orientation that connects one doorway to the current unexplored doorway.
steps.confirmRoomPlacement: The orientation is selected. Choose Confirm Placement; only after placement do you resolve the room text and symbol.
steps.discoveryCardType: This room has an Event symbol, so it revealed an Event card. Item symbols reveal Item cards, and Omen symbols reveal Omen cards. Read the card kind and face before resolving its instruction.
steps.rollEvent: The Event card is public. Click Roll Event to make the Might check on this card; the dice and event result stay on the table for every player to read.
steps.useRabbitFoot: The Book changed the check to Knowledge. Now click Rabbit's Foot, choose one die to reroll, then click Confirm Rabbit's Foot.
steps.rabbitFootResult: Rabbit's Foot has finished the reroll. The Event card and dice were already visible during this public roll; when there is no new choice, the game moves into damage allocation.
steps.finish: Choose the trait that takes 1 physical damage, then confirm the allocation.
steps.returnToTableAfterDamage: The damage is now applied to the trait track. Choose Return to Table to go back to your action entry.

omenConfirmation.title: Omen: Haunt Roll
omenConfirmation.description: A room with an Omen symbol reveals an Omen card. When you draw an Omen card, read its text aloud, place it face-up in front of you, and make a haunt roll. Roll dice equal to the total number of Omens held by all players; on a result of 5+, the haunt begins.

steps.setupOmenConfirmation: A room with an Omen symbol reveals an Omen card. When you draw an Omen card, read its text aloud, place it face-up in front of you, and make a haunt roll. Roll dice equal to the total number of Omens held by all players; on a result of 5+, the haunt begins.
steps.hauntRiskTrack: The highlighted slot shows the number of Omens discovered. The haunt roll uses the total number of Omens held by all players; on a result of 5+, the haunt begins.
steps.confirmOmenCard: This Omen card came from an Omen symbol. When you draw an Omen, roll dice equal to the total number of Omens held by all players; on a result of 5+, the haunt begins. After this roll is complete, press Confirm to continue.
steps.review: The haunt roll was below 5+; you now possess the Omen, and the haunt has not begun.

hauntNaturalTrigger.title: Natural Haunt Trigger: Omen to First Hero Action
hauntNaturalTrigger.description: Continue through normal turns: control only your own turn, let teammate turns advance as public results, read the Hero Scenario Book when a teammate reveals the haunt, then complete the first hero objective action: finding the Mummy's true name.

steps.setupNaturalHauntFlow: This section teaches the majority hero perspective: you end your turn beside the Library and control only your own turn, while teammates gain Omens through normal turns. The traitor book has its own chapter.
steps.handOffToTeammateOne: Choose End Turn to pass play to the next explorer. Haunt risk rises as players actually gain Omens.
steps.watchTeammateOmenTurns: It is not your turn now. Wait while teammate 1 explores an Omen room; this only reveals the first Omen and a failed haunt roll.
steps.teammateOmenResults: Teammate 1 gains the Ring, and one haunt die stays below 5+. Play now passes normally to teammate 2.
steps.watchTeammateTwoOmenTurn: Teammate 2 moves beside the Observatory, explores the next Omen room, and reveals Dog. The second Omen uses two dice for the haunt roll.
steps.teammateTwoOmenResults: After teammate 2 confirms Dog, the turn returns to you. Ring and Dog are in play, so the next Omen will roll three dice.
steps.handOffToTeammateSecondCycle: It is your turn again. Choose End Turn to keep watching teammates explore through the normal rules; you are not acting for them.
steps.watchTeammateHauntTrigger: Teammate 1 explores south from the Observatory, reveals another Omen room, and gains the Mask. The third Omen rolls three haunt dice.
steps.teammateConfirmHauntTrigger: Teammate 1 reads the Mask and the three haunt dice, then confirms after seeing the public result.
steps.heroReaderOpened: After the public haunt reveal, teammate 1 is the revealer and becomes the traitor. You are still a hero; the game first shows the hero opening cutscene, not the goal page of the Scenario Book. Read this one-time opening.
steps.heroReaderTurnPage: After the opening cutscene, choose Enter Scenario Book to open the Hero Scenario Book goal page; that page explains finding the true name, learning the spell, and banishing the Mummy.
steps.heroReaderGoal: The Hero Scenario Book goal page says the hero can find the true name in the Sarcophagus room, Study, or Library. You are beside the Library now, so after reading you should move into it.
steps.heroReaderClose: After reading the Hero Scenario Book goal page, close it and return to the table; the next hero turn follows this goal.
steps.waitForHeroTurnAfterHaunt: After the haunt begins, turn order continues. Teammate 2 ends their turn through the normal flow, then play returns to you; you are still on the Upper Landing, and the goal just told you the Library can research the Mummy's history.
steps.openLibraryMoveAfterGoal: You have read the hero goal and know why the Library matters. Choose Move first to show the rooms reachable from the Upper Landing.
steps.moveToLibraryAfterGoal: The Library is now an adjacent move target. Choose the Library to move into it; only then can you find the Mummy's true name.
steps.heroStudyNameRoll: The hero goal allows a 6+ Knowledge check in the Sarcophagus room, Study, or Library to find the true name. You are in the Library, so choose Find the Mummy's True Name; success gains the first knowledge token.
steps.heroStudyNameResult: The check succeeds: the heroes gain the first knowledge token and record the true name. After reading the roll result, press Confirm to return to the table.
steps.heroStudyNameCloseout: The result has landed on the hero objective progress. Each hero can attempt only one haunt objective step per turn; end this turn first, then learn the banishment spell on a later legal turn with the Book.

tradeAndAgreement.title: Trade: Confirm, Then Agreement
tradeAndAgreement.description: Trade Items and Omens with an explorer in the same room; the trade completes only when both explorers agree.

steps.setupTrade: On your turn, you can trade Items and Omens with an explorer in the same room, as long as both explorers agree. The trade can be unequal, and either side may only give or only take.
steps.startTrade: You have moved into the same Hallway as your teammate. Click Trade first to enter trade selection, then choose which possessions each side gives.
steps.chooseTradeItem: Select the Medical Kit in your inventory as the item you give. Keep the Book and Rabbit's Foot for the later Event roll.
steps.chooseTradeTarget: Select the teammate in the same room. You can give or take Items and Omens; click the card you want.
steps.chooseTradeReturn: To have the teammate give the Map, click the Map in that explorer's inventory. You can also submit a proposal where only the Medical Kit is given.
steps.sendTradeRequest: After choosing what each side gives or takes, tap Submit Proposal to send this exact trade proposal to the teammate.
steps.requestWaiting: The trade proposal is sent; possessions do not move until the receiver agrees. In this tutorial, the teammate responds through the real trade flow, so you do not switch seats or confirm for them.
steps.tradeReview: The teammate agrees to the trade: the Map enters your inventory, the Medical Kit enters the teammate inventory, and the Book plus Rabbit's Foot stay ready for the later Event.

hauntActions.title: Mummy Rampage: Hero Goal and Banishment
hauntActions.description: Heroes must speak the mummy's true name and banish it before the wedding; the traitor seeks to unite the Mummy and the Girl.

steps.setupReadyToExorcise: Hero victory: banish the Mummy before it marries the Girl. Traitor victory: bring the Mummy and Girl together.
steps.helpEntry: Open the haunt book and read your goal and victory condition.
steps.hauntActions: Heroes must speak the Mummy's true name. In order, make a 6+ Knowledge check in the Sarcophagus Room, Study, or Library to find it; then a hero carrying the Book makes a 6+ Knowledge check to learn the banishment spell. With 2 tokens and the Book in the Mummy's room, any hero in that room can attack with Sanity. Each hero may try only one step per turn.
steps.exorciseJack: Choose Banish Mummy to attack the Mummy with Sanity.
steps.banishMummy: Attack the Mummy with Sanity; heroes win when the Mummy is defeated.
steps.endgameReview: The Mummy crumbles into sand and blows away. The heroes win.

heroAttackPath.title: Hero Attacks the Traitor
heroAttackPath.description: After investigating Jack, a hero can attack the traitor to help release Jack's Spirit.

steps.setupHeroAttack: The hero has investigated Jack; when the traitor is in the same room, attacking the traitor grants an extra bonus.
steps.heroAttackObjective: Open the Hero book and read the goal involving the traitor and Jack's Spirit.
steps.attackTraitor: Choose Attack Traitor, then click the traitor on the map. The attacker and defender roll the attributes required by the attack; investigating Jack grants an extra bonus.
steps.heroAttackReview: The attacker and defender roll, compare their results, and resolve damage from the difference.

jackSpiritPath.title: Jack's Spirit Acts
jackSpiritPath.description: After the traitor dies, Jack's Spirit moves and attacks heroes as a monster.

steps.setupJackSpirit: After the traitor dies, Jack's Spirit continues acting as a monster.
steps.jackSpiritObjective: Jack's Spirit attacks heroes; when it returns to the traitor's corpse room, the traitor revives and returns to play.
steps.jackSpiritAttack: Choose Attack Hero, then click the hero in the same room.
steps.jackSpiritReview: The monster attacks with Might; compare the attacker and defender results and resolve damage from the difference.

traitorPath.title: Traitor View: Goal and Mummy Actions
traitorPath.description: Read the Traitor goal, then control the Mummy through the monster turn: movement, attack, and stealing. The final Girl plus Holy Symbol or Ring handoff needs a separate near-victory position.
traitorPath.victoryTitle: Traitor Topic: Girl and Holy Symbol Victory Chain
traitorPath.victoryDescription: Start from the legal traitor victory-chain position: the traitor, Girl, Mummy, Sarcophagus, and Holy Symbol are already in the same room, then hand over the Girl and Holy Symbol by the rules.

steps.setupTraitorTurn: This section starts from the legal traitor victory-chain position: the traitor, Girl, Mummy, Sarcophagus, and Holy Symbol are already in the same room. Read the goal first, then make the handoffs.
steps.traitorObjective: Open the Traitor's Tome and read the victory condition involving the Girl, Holy Symbol or Ring, and Sarcophagus, plus the Mummy's rules.
steps.pickUpGirl: Entering the room with the Girl token lets you take the Girl Omen; choose Pick Up Girl.
steps.giveGirlToMummy: While carrying the Girl in the Mummy's room, you may give her to the Mummy; choose Give Girl.
steps.giveOmenToMummy: The Mummy carries the Girl; give the Holy Symbol or Ring to the Mummy in the same room. Choose Give Holy Symbol.
steps.traitorFinish: The Mummy carries the Girl and the Holy Symbol or Ring back to the Sarcophagus. The traitor wins.

mummyMonsterActions.title: Mummy Monster Actions
mummyMonsterActions.description: The traitor controls the Mummy through movement, same-room attack, and stealing.

steps.setupMonsterMove: During the monster turn, the Mummy starts in the Sarcophagus room; the Girl is in a distant room, and the traitor controls the Mummy.
steps.monsterRoll: Choose Mummy Movement. The result determines the Mummy's movement; on 0 or 1, it can teleport to any room in the house.
steps.monsterRollReview: Read the Mummy's movement result, then choose Back to Board.
steps.monsterMoveTarget: On 0 or 1, the Mummy can teleport to any room in the house. Choose Move Mummy, then click the Mummy and the discovered room with the Girl.
steps.monsterMoveResult: After entering the Girl's room, the Mummy carries the Girl; the Girl token stays beside the Mummy.
steps.setupAttack: When the Mummy shares a room with a hero, it must make a same-room attack if possible; choose Mummy Attack.
steps.attackForced: When the Mummy shares a room with a hero, it must attack the hero first.
steps.attackTarget: Choose Mummy Attack, then click the hero in the same room. The traitor and a dead explorer are not attack targets.
steps.attackRollReview: Read only the attack roll comparison: the Mummy wins and would deal 2 or more damage; choose Back to Board to enter the follow-up choice.
steps.attackReward: This is the Mummy reward choice: the rules allow stealing one Item or Omen instead of reducing traits; choose Steal Map.
steps.stealResult: Stealing replaces damage; the robbed hero does not lose traits.
